title: Describing Positions
introduction: Explain where objects are using position words.
definition: Explain where objects are using position words.
rules: Use between for a position separating two things.
Use next to, opposite, behind and in front of to describe positions.

grammar.description: in the space separating two things

examples.question: The lamp is in the space separating two chairs. It is ___ them.
steps: Between describes a position separating two objects.

examples.question: The shop is across from the bank. It is ___ the bank.

exercises.question: The lamp is in the space separating two chairs. It is ___ them.
exercises.solution: Between describes a position separating two objects.

exercises.question: The shop is across from the bank. It is ___ the bank.
The bag is beside the bed. It is ___ the bed. (next to or above)
The clock is higher than the door. It is ___ the door.
The cat is at the back of the sofa. It is ___ the sofa.
The rug is below the table. It is ___ the table.

summary: Explain where objects are using position words. Use between for a position separating two things.
